Bus crash in Jharkhand kills three Nepali pilgrims

A bus carrying Nepali pilgrims, identified as 'Kanwariyas', collided with a parked truck in Koderma, Jharkhand, resulting in the deaths of three individuals. Ten other passengers sustained injuries in the accident. The bus was reportedly carrying pilgrims from Nepal.
